== Title ==
<span lang="ja">オビ＝ワンのケープ</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-57o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">２フォース消費して、反乱軍かエイリアンに配備する。耐：損耗＜５を得る。戦闘開始時に配備されていたら、１フォース消費して、能力値＝１の相手のキャラクターを一人選び、移動を強要する（移動コストなし）。移動しなかったら、そのキャラクターを直ちにロストデッキへ置く。耐：損耗＜５。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">気高きジェダイと神秘な力のシンボル。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' Obi-Wan's Cape.

'''Card text:''' Use 2 Force to deploy on a Rebel or alien, who gains immunity to attrition less than 5. If deployed when battle begins, you may use 1 Force to choose an opposing character with ability 1 and force them to move at no movement cost. If they do not move, place them immediately in the Lost Pile. Immune to attrition less than 5.

'''Lore:''' A symbol of the noble Jedi and their mysterious power.

== Statistics ==
* '''Destiny:''' 4
* '''Uniqueness:''' Unique (one marker)

Remaining printed symbols and statistics await verification.<ref name="jp-face" />
